F1 involution frame: per-corner frame CH(t->A).H_A.CX.CH.CX (4 CX) turns every bright pair into X_F (x) prod_c Z_{A_c}; dark flag from the frame marker B_c gated by t_c-bar plus one outer m-AND per corner (reads only the 8 outer m bits); one 6-term multiplexed Rz on F (gzu/t flags).

F2 pair frame: per corner a 2-CX leg frame + type-selected C_{jA}(X) makes both partners of every bright pair equal except the flip bit F=j_b; one rccx per corner leaves the bright flag; U_B = one (g, z, t)-multiplexed X rotation of F (6 Rz), U_E = 4 phases.

per-corner 10-CX gadget (two Margolus + CX + 2 CH, partner map X on one leg, dark flag left in a corner ancilla), 5-CX fold that exposes the corner types t_c as qubits, 4-input AND of the bright flags, 12-term Walsh multiplexed Rx on j_b (CX 132).

Spectral frame: 2-CX corner frames + type-controlled CH + padding put every bright pair on one flip qubit F (H_B = kappa(t) g X_F), outer-AND dark bits, pairwise NOR flags, 14-term exact Walsh phase polynomial of the 7-point spectrum on F.
